from fractions import Fraction as F
import json

# Gaussian rational arithmetic; no historical implementation is imported.
def c(x=0,y=0): return (F(x),F(y))
def add(a,b): return (a[0]+b[0],a[1]+b[1])
def mul(a,b): return (a[0]*b[0]-a[1]*b[1],a[0]*b[1]+a[1]*b[0])
def conj(a): return (a[0],-a[1])
zero=c()
def mat(fn): return [[fn(i,j) for j in range(4)] for i in range(4)]
def mm(A,B):
    return mat(lambda i,j: sumc(mul(A[i][k],B[k][j]) for k in range(4)))
def sumc(xs):
    z=zero
    for x in xs: z=add(z,x)
    return z
def dag(A): return mat(lambda i,j:conj(A[j][i]))
def sub(A,B): return mat(lambda i,j:add(A[i][j],(-B[i][j][0],-B[i][j][1])))
def com(A,B): return sub(mm(A,B),mm(B,A))
def iszero(A): return all(x==zero for row in A for x in row)
def evolve(V,r): return mm(mm(V,r),dag(V))
def dstr(r):
    assert all(r[i][i][1]==0 for i in range(4))
    return [str(r[i][i][0]) for i in range(4)]
def pop(r,site): return sum(r[i][i][0] for i in range(4) if ((i>>(1-site))&1))

I=mat(lambda i,j:c(int(i==j)))
perm=[0,2,1,3]
S=mat(lambda i,j:c(int(i==perm[j])))
V=mat(lambda i,j:add(mul(c(F(1,2),F(-1,2)),I[i][j]),
                         mul(c(F(1,2),F(1,2)),S[i][j])))
r0=mat(lambda i,j:c(F([18,12,6,4][i],40) if i==j else 0))
rhalf=evolve(V,r0)
rbar=mat(lambda i,j:rhalf[i][j] if i//2==j//2 else zero)
expected=mat(lambda i,j:c(F([18,9,9,4][i],40) if i==j else 0))
assert iszero(sub(rbar,expected))
assert iszero(sub(mm(V,V),S))
assert iszero(sub(mm(V,dag(V)),I))
nA=mat(lambda i,j:c(i//2 if i==j else 0))
nB=mat(lambda i,j:c(i%2 if i==j else 0))
N=mat(lambda i,j:add(nA[i][j],nB[i][j]))
assert iszero(com(rbar,S)) and iszero(com(rbar,N))
assert iszero(sub(evolve(V,rbar),rbar))
rundo=evolve(V,rhalf)
assert iszero(sub(rundo,evolve(S,r0)))
assert pop(rbar,0)==pop(rbar,1)==F(13,40)
assert pop(rundo,0)==F(2,5)
cov=rbar[3][3][0]-pop(rbar,0)*pop(rbar,1)
assert cov==F(-9,1600)
Hswap=sub(I,S)
assert not iszero(com(Hswap,nA))
gibbs_defect=F(9,40)**2-F(18,40)*F(4,40)
assert gibbs_defect==F(9,1600)
latest5=F(1,2)+F(1,256)+5*F(1,16)
end=F(17,8)
assert latest5==F(209,256)
prefix_bound=(1+9*F(22,7))*F(1,10**9)
published=F(3,10**8)
assert prefix_bound < published
gap=F(3,40)-2*published
out={
"status":"PASS_EXACT_OLD_RESULT_COROLLARY",
"calculation_scope":"4x4 exact Gaussian-rational blocks and rational temporal/error bounds; no 15360-state replay, no new research group",
"prepared_AB_diagonal":dstr(r0),
"first_half_AB_diagonal":dstr(rhalf),
"retained_record_AB_diagonal":dstr(rbar),
"retained_record_marginals":["27/40","13/40"],
"reversed_record_final_AB_diagonal":dstr(rundo),
"beta_c_times_gap":"log(27/13)",
"number_covariance":str(cov),
"nonproduct_thermal_ratio_defect":str(gibbs_defect),
"unitary_half_squared_is_swap":True,
"commutes_with_swap_and_free_energy":True,
"arbitrary_remaining_half_angle_invariance":"analytic consequence of the exact commutators, not angle sampling",
"local_modular_flow_not_full_swap_flow":"[n_A,I-S_AB] is nonzero, although local K_c is affine in n_A",
"common_theta_window":[str(latest5),str(end)],
"physical_time":"tau=s*theta",
"window_length":str(end-latest5),
"uniform_prefix_error_using_pi_less_22_over_7":str(prefix_bound),
"prefix_error_margin_below_3e_minus_8":str(published-prefix_bound),
"two_program_output_gap_lower":str(gap),
"scope_checks":{
"nonselective_reduced_state_only":True,
"no_new_intermediate_readout":True,
"L2_is_separate_initial_program_not_late_reprogramming":True,
"all_records_inventory_and_partners_retained":True,
"local_free_modular_identity_not_AB_full_flow":True,
"no_attraction_recovery_or_infinite_reuse_claim":True,
"no_new_geometry_or_entropy_identity":True
}}
